summary: Runtime executor: sessions -> sandbox, repo checkout, checkpointer, tools wiring, run record
epic_summary: WS-B Agent runtime (Deep Agents, Docker sandbox backend, subagents, skills, stuck detection)
description:
Due 2026-11-05.

## Do

* Implement copilot's `RunExecutor` (ANVIL-11): one sandbox per session (reused across messages), destroyed on session close or kept 24 h on handoff.
* Checkout at the ticket's base ref with `--single-branch` (TC leak control: the mirror's main contains the withheld fixes); create `anvil/<key-lower>-<slug>`.
* Postgres checkpointer + store (`/memories/`), thread id = session id; approvals resume the LangGraph interrupt.
* Wire devin's tools (ANVIL-13) with the approval policy; merge offered only when merge_policy allows.
* Run record: base sha, branch, sandbox image digest, resolved model ids, skills git sha, prompt hash, budgets, artifacts.

## Acceptance

From the UI: new session on rtems -> "build erc32 and run hello" streams to the end; run record complete.

comments.body: [claude] PR https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/8 (stacked on #6). Executor with start/resume/cancel, single-branch checkout, sandbox offline after checkout by default (leak control: an explicit `git fetch origin main` would otherwise reach withheld fixes), run.record event. 15 tests pass incl. a real-container clone test. Open: integration with copilot's API (ANVIL-11) and the RTEMS image.
[claude] Status 14:05: the code is complete and merged (#8, #12, #23, #26 wiring). Acceptance ("build erc32 and run hello" from the UI) is blocked on PR #31 (ANVIL-12).

[claude] Executor bug found by M1 run c820a577 (details on ANVIL-24): a ToolError from an outward tool ended the whole run instead of going back to the model, and `full_name()` accepted the sandbox path `/workspace/rtems` as a repo. PR #45 fixes both (reviewer devin). Stays open until the M1 re-run passes end to end.
